character: A state-owned Adirondack ski mountain near Lake Placid, run by ORDA, with one of the largest vertical drops in the eastern US and steep, often wind-exposed upper terrain. It hosted the alpine events of the 1980 Winter Olympics.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain and lessons are concentrated at the Bear Den area near the main base, away from the steep upper mountain. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson programs.

season.notes: OnTheSnow projects Nov 21, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). No 2026-27 opening or closing date found in research as of 2026-09-28. ORDA announced its 2025-26 opening dates for Belleayre, Gore and Whiteface only on 2025-11-21 (see the ORDA release in More links), so 2026-27 dates may not appear until around November 2026. The 2025-26 Whiteface date itself and past actual opening dates were not captured.

prices.note: Search summary labelled this the 2026-27 peak adult rate, but it comes from third-party listings whose season is unclear (a snowstash page in the same results was titled 2025/26). Confirm at source.
